assets.name: code
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: an original two-frame pixel-art animation sprite sheet for a polished cyberpunk town game, two equal SQUARE cells arranged horizontally, overall 2:1 aspect ratio, genuinely transparent background. A compact coding street workbench: dark gunmetal waist-high console, broad rectangular glass monitor with a nearly front-facing face, small recessed keyboard shelf, thick short pedestal and bolted feet. The monitor contains abstract cyan circuitry, small horizontal data bars and a tiny square cursor, absolutely no readable letters or numbers. Match premium detailed pixel-art town props: crisp deliberate chunky pixels, rich dark gunmetal bevels, modest cyan #49dcd7 contained glow, subtle purple-gray metal shadows, front/side three-quarter ground view with only a little top surface visible. No robots, people, text, letters, digits, floor tiles, backdrop, captions or separator line. Both cells show EXACTLY the same workstation chassis, same size, camera, x/y position within cell, physical details, grounding, screen frame and feet. Only the display contents/contained light effect changes between the two cells: frame 1 initial pulse pattern, frame 2 a clearly shifted pulse/sweep/cursor/bubble/node pattern. All animation is INSIDE the broad rectangular screen/window; no external sparks changing silhouette. Keep ample transparent margin around each object, bottom of feet aligned to the same baseline at about 94% cell height. Entire object fits inside each cell. No wispy shadows, no blurry halos, no floating pixels outside silhouette. Crisp opaque metal, transparent exterior. This is a sprite sheet, not a UI mockup.

Clean hard alpha cutout, fully opaque visible pixels with fully transparent exterior and center; no wispy glow fringes, no blurry gradients, no haze, no drop shadow, no checkerboard. Accent highlights can look luminous through contrast but must have solid crisp boundaries. Preserve generous legibility at actual tiny UI size.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a game-ready two-frame animation sprite sheet for a tiny rooftop status beacon in a cyberpunk pixel-art town. Place the SAME tiny squat metallic technological beacon core at the EXACT center of both cells (25% canvas width,50% canvas height;75% canvas width,50% canvas height). The core is a small angular luminous lens in a dark titanium housing, about 18% of each cell width. Exactly FOUR short clean stepped pixel rays extend north/east/south/west with tiny gaps around the core. Left cell is animation frame1: short restrained rays. Right cell is frame2: same IDENTICAL core, same location/size/perspective, only the four rays become 2 logical pixels longer and brighter. Palette: working-status luminous CYAN #49dcd7, pale cyan highlights, navy/titanium housing. Both cells cyan. Frame2 rays brighter pale-cyan at tips.
